PreToolUse.name: block-env-edits
PreToolUse.description: Prevent accidental .env file modifications — use Vault instead
PreToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.env($|\.)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: .env files must be edited manually. Update Vault secrets instead.'; exit 1; fi

PreToolUse.name: block-lockfile-edits
PreToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '(package-lock|yarn\.lock|pnpm-lock|go\.sum|Cargo\.lock|requirements\.txt\.lock)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Lock files should not be manually edited'; exit 1; fi

PreToolUse.name: block-credential-exposure
PreToolUse.description: Block writing files that might contain raw credentials
PreToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '(credentials|secrets|tokens)\.'; then echo 'WARNING: Verify no raw secrets are being written to this file'; fi

PostToolUse.name: auto-format-python
PostToolUse.description: Auto-format Python files with Ruff after editing
PostToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then command -v ruff &>/dev/null && ruff format "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null && ruff check --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

PostToolUse.name: validate-dockerfile
PostToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qi 'dockerfile'; then command -v hadolint &>/dev/null && hadolint "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

PostToolUse.name: validate-yaml
PostToolUse.description: Validate YAML syntax after editing docker-compose or k8s manifests
PostToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '(docker-compose|k8s|kubernetes|manifests).*\.ya?ml$'; then python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH'))" 2>/dev/null || echo 'WARNING: YAML syntax validation failed'; fi

PostToolUse.name: validate-terraform
PostToolUse.description: Format and validate Terraform files after editing
PostToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.tf$'; then command -v terraform &>/dev/null && terraform fmt "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

PostToolUse.name: track-all-changes
PostToolUse.description: Log all file operations for task tracking
